title: Three Kingdoms 8: Reunification of the Three Kingdoms Under Jin

series.title: Three Kingdoms 8: Reunification of the Three Kingdoms Under Jin

fullText.simplified:
第一章、这个人是谁

    公元264年1月，四川成都，蜀国皇宫又迎来了一位新主人——魏国的钟会。这是在短短的半年时间里，蜀国皇宫迎来的第三位主人。去年10月，这儿的主人还是蜀国的皇帝刘禅。11月，魏国攻打蜀国，魏国大将邓艾带兵攻破了蜀国的大门，蜀国皇帝刘禅向邓艾投降，皇宫的主人变成了邓艾。四个月后，魏国收到消息，说邓艾有造反之心，要留在蜀国自己当皇帝，于是派出另一位大将来抓邓艾，这位新来的大将就是钟会。钟会聪明勇敢，一到蜀国就用计策抓住了邓艾，于是蜀国皇宫的主人就又变成了钟会。吵闹了半年的蜀国皇宫终于安静了，但这份安静只持续了短短的一个月。一个月后，钟会造反，在一名投降的蜀国将军的帮助下，他在皇宫内发起叛乱，但因时机掌握不成熟，造反失败。
    这是上元节的第二天，微风轻轻吹着，冷雨飘在成都街头。
    一队魏国士兵拉着一辆辆装满死人的牛车，正慢慢地从蜀国皇宫里走出来。昨天皇宫里发生了叛乱，死了很多人。现在叛乱平息了，魏国军队正在清理现场，要把那些死在皇宫里的人拉到城外去。
    最后一辆牛车由一老一小两个士兵拉着，他们是爷孙俩。他们拉的牛车上只有两个人，这两个人身上都插满了箭，脸上和衣服上全是血，看样子是死在战乱中的。
    “爷爷，这个人是谁？”孙子看着牛车上的人问。
    “钟会钟将军，你不认识吗？”爷爷回答。
    “钟将军我当然认识，他是我们魏国的大将军。我问的是他旁边的这个人。”
    “他叫……姜维。”
    “姜维？他也是将军吗？”
    “他是蜀国的将军，一个月前刚刚投降的。”
    “是投降的将军啊！既然都投降了，为什么还要和钟将军一起造反呢？”孙子好奇地问。
    “我想他不是真的投降，像他这样的人，怎么会投降呢？”爷爷回答。
    “爷爷您了解他？他是怎样的人？”
    “我不了解他，但我知道他的师父。他师父那么优秀的人，教出来的徒弟一定也是优秀的。”
    “他师父是谁？”
    “蜀国诸葛亮。姜维是他唯一的徒弟。”
    “是诸葛亮啊！但是诸葛亮死了都有二十多年了，他什么时候还收了徒弟？爷爷，这是什么时候的事？”
    爷爷的脚步变慢了，白发被风吹起，他望着前方飘着细雨的街道，自言自语般说道：“什么时候的事呢？我也记不清了，只记得那时候司马大将军还活着，诸葛亮也还没有死，他的白马大将军赵云也还在……他们都还在，那些英雄都还在……”
fullText.traditional:
第一章、這個人是誰

    公元264年1月，四川成都，蜀國皇宮又迎來了一位新主人——魏國的鍾會。這是在短短的半年時間裡，蜀國皇宮迎來的第三位主人。去年10月，這兒的主人還是蜀國的皇帝劉禪。11月，魏國攻打蜀國，魏國大將鄧艾帶兵攻破了蜀國的大門，蜀國皇帝劉禪向鄧艾投降，皇宮的主人變成了鄧艾。四個月後，魏國收到消息，說鄧艾有造反之心，要留在蜀國自己當皇帝，於是派出另一位大將來抓鄧艾，這位新來的大將就是鍾會。鍾會聰明勇敢，一到蜀國就用計策抓住了鄧艾，於是蜀國皇宮的主人就又變成了鍾會。吵鬧了半年的蜀國皇宮終於安靜了，但這份安靜只持續了短短的一個月。一個月後，鍾會造反，在一名投降的蜀國將軍的幫助下，他在皇宮內發起叛亂，但因時機掌握不成熟，造反失敗。
    這是上元節的第二天，微風輕輕吹著，冷雨飄在成都街頭。
    一隊魏國士兵拉著一輛輛裝滿死人的牛車，正慢慢地從蜀國皇宮裡走出來。昨天皇宮裡發生了叛亂，死了很多人。現在叛亂平息了，魏國軍隊正在清理現場，要把那些死在皇宮裡的人拉到城外去。
    最後一輛牛車由一老一小兩個士兵拉著，他們是爺孫倆。他們拉的牛車上只有兩個人，這兩個人身上都插滿了箭，臉上和衣服上全是血，看樣子是死在戰亂中的。
    “爺爺，這個人是誰？”孫子看著牛車上的人問。
    “鍾會鍾將軍，你不認識嗎？”爺爺回答。
    “鍾將軍我當然認識，他是我們魏國的大將軍。我問的是他旁邊的這個人。”
    “他叫……姜維。”
    “姜維？他也是將軍嗎？”
    “他是蜀國的將軍，一個月前剛剛投降的。”
    “是投降的將軍啊！既然都投降了，為什麼還要和鍾將軍一起造反呢？”孫子好奇地問。
    “我想他不是真的投降，像他這樣的人，怎麼會投降呢？”爺爺回答。
    “爺爺您了解他？他是怎樣的人？”
    “我不了解他，但我知道他的師父。他師父那麼優秀的人，教出來的徒弟一定也是優秀的。”
    “他師父是誰？”
    “蜀國諸葛亮。姜維是他唯一的徒弟。”
    “是諸葛亮啊！但是諸葛亮死了都有二十多年了，他什麼時候還收了徒弟？爺爺，這是什麼時候的事？”
    爺爺的腳步變慢了，白髮被風吹起，他望著前方飄著細雨的街道，自言自語般說道：“什麼時候的事呢？我也記不清了，只記得那時候司馬大將軍還活著，諸葛亮也還沒有死，他的白馬大將軍趙雲也還在……他們都還在，那些英雄都還在……”

sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù liǎo jiě tā dàn wǒ zhī dào tā de shī fu
sentences.english: “I didn’t know him well, but I knew his master.

sentences.simplified: 他师父那么优秀的人，教出来的徒弟一定也是优秀的。”
sentences.traditional: 他師父那麼優秀的人，教出來的徒弟一定也是優秀的。”
sentences.pinyin: tā shī fu nà me yōu xiù de rén jiāo chu lai de tú dì yí dìng yě shì yōu xiù de
sentences.english: His master was such an outstanding person, so a disciple taught by him must also be outstanding.”

sentences.simplified: “他师父是谁？”
sentences.traditional: “他師父是誰？”
sentences.pinyin: tā shī fu shì shéi
sentences.english: “Who was his master?”

sentences.simplified: “蜀国诸葛亮。姜维是他唯一的徒弟。”
sentences.traditional: “蜀國諸葛亮。姜維是他唯一的徒弟。”
sentences.pinyin: shǔ guó zhū gě liàng jiāng wéi shì tā wéi yī de tú dì
sentences.english: “Zhuge Liang of Shu. Jiang Wei was his only disciple.”

sentences.simplified: “是诸葛亮啊！但是诸葛亮死了都有二十多年了，他什么时候还收了徒弟？
sentences.traditional: “是諸葛亮啊！但是諸葛亮死了都有二十多年了，他什麼時候還收了徒弟？
sentences.pinyin: shì zhū gě liàng a dàn shì zhū gě liàng sǐ le dōu yǒu èr shí duō nián le tā shén me shí hou hái shōu le tú dì
sentences.english: “Zhuge Liang! But Zhuge Liang has been dead for over twenty years. When did he take on a disciple?

sentences.simplified: 爷爷，这是什么时候的事？”
sentences.traditional: 爺爺，這是什麼時候的事？”
sentences.pinyin: yé ye zhè shì shén me shí hou de shì
sentences.english: Grandpa, when did this happen?”

sentences.simplified: 爷爷的脚步变慢了，白发被风吹起，
sentences.traditional: 爺爺的腳步變慢了，白髮被風吹起，
sentences.pinyin: yé ye de jiǎo bù biàn màn le bái fà bèi fēng chuī qǐ
sentences.english: The grandfather walked more slowly, and his white hair started blowing in the wind.

sentences.simplified: 他望着前方飘着细雨的街道，自言自语般说道：
sentences.traditional: 他望著前方飄著細雨的街道，自言自語般說道：
sentences.pinyin: tā wàng zhe qián fāng piāo zhe xì yǔ de jiē dào zì yán zì yǔ bān shuō dào
sentences.english: He looked at the street ahead, where light rain was floating, and murmured to himself, ..

sentences.simplified: “什么时候的事呢？我也记不清了，
sentences.traditional: “什麼時候的事呢？我也記不清了，
sentences.pinyin: shén me shí hou de shì ne wǒ yě jì bù qīng le
sentences.english: .. “When did this happen? I can’t remember clearly.

sentences.simplified: 只记得那时候司马大将军还活着，诸葛亮也还没有死，
sentences.traditional: 只記得那時候司馬大將軍還活著，諸葛亮也還沒有死，
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ jì de nà shí hou sī mǎ dà jiāng jūn hái huó zhe zhū gě liàng yě hái méi yǒu sǐ
sentences.english: I only remember that back then, General Sima was still alive, Zhuge Liang hadn’t died yet, ..

sentences.simplified: 他的白马大将军赵云也还在……
sentences.traditional: 他的白馬大將軍趙雲也還在……
sentences.pinyin: tā de bái mǎ dà jiāng jūn zhào yún yě hái zài
sentences.english: .. and his White Horse General, Zhao Yun, was also still alive …

sentences.simplified: 他们都还在，那些英雄都还在……”
sentences.traditional: 他們都還在，那些英雄都還在……”
sentences.pinyin: tā men dōu hái zài nà xiē yīng xióng dōu hái zài
sentences.english: They were all still alive. All those heroes were still alive …”

sentence_translations: Chapter 1: Who Is This Person?
In January 264 AD, in Chengdu, Sichuan, the palace of the state of Shu welcomed a new master—Zhong Hui of the state of Wei.
This was the third master that the palace of Shu had welcomed in just six months.
In October of the previous year, the master here was still Liu Shan, the emperor of the state of Shu.
In November, the state of Wei attacked the state of Shu. The Wei general Deng Ai led his troops to breach the gates of Shu.
The emperor of Shu, Liu Shan, surrendered to Deng Ai, and Deng Ai became the master of the palace.
Four months later, the state of Wei received news that Deng Ai intended to rebel and wanted to stay in Shu to become emperor himself.
Consequently, they dispatched another general to capture Deng Ai. This newly arrived general was Zhong Hui.
Zhong Hui was smart and brave. As soon as he arrived in the state of Shu, he devised a plan to capture Deng Ai.
Consequently, Zhong Hui became the master of the palace of Shu.
The palace of Shu, which had been in turmoil for six months, finally became quiet.
But this peace lasted only a brief month.
A month later, Zhong Hui rebelled. With the help of a surrendered Shu general, he launched a rebellion within the palace.
However, because the time was not ripe, the rebellion failed.
This was the day after the Lantern Festival.
A gentle breeze was blowing, and cold rain was drifting on the streets of Chengdu.
A group of Wei soldiers were slowly pulling carts filled with dead bodies out of the palace of Shu.
A rebellion had broken out in the palace the day before, and many people had died. Now, the rebellion had been quelled.
The Wei army was cleaning up the site, taking those who died in the palace out of the city.
The last ox cart was pulled by two soldiers, an old man and a young boy, who were grandfather and grandson.
There were only two people on the ox cart they pulled, and the bodies of these two people were both pierced with arrows.
Their faces and clothes were completely covered in blood. They appeared to have died in the chaos of battle.
“Grandpa, who is this person?” the grandson asked, looking at the people on the cart.
“That’s General Zhong Hui. Don’t you recognize him?” the grandfather replied.
“Of course, I recognize General Zhong. He is our state of Wei’s great general. I’m asking about the person next to him.”
“His name is … Jiang Wei.”
“Jiang Wei? Is he also a general?”
“He was a general of the state of Shu, who just surrendered a month ago.”
“He was a surrendered general!
Since he had already surrendered, why did he still rebel with General Zhong?” the grandson asked curiously.
“I don’t think he really surrendered. How could someone like him surrender?” the grandfather replied.
“Grandpa, did you know him well? What kind of person was he?”
“I didn’t know him well, but I knew his master.
His master was such an outstanding person, so a disciple taught by him must also be outstanding.”
“Who was his master?”
“Zhuge Liang of Shu. Jiang Wei was his only disciple.”
“Zhuge Liang! But Zhuge Liang has been dead for over twenty years. When did he take on a disciple?
Grandpa, when did this happen?”
The grandfather walked more slowly, and his white hair started blowing in the wind.
He looked at the street ahead, where light rain was floating, and murmured to himself, ..
.. “When did this happen? I can’t remember clearly.
I only remember that back then, General Sima was still alive, Zhuge Liang hadn’t died yet, ..
.. and his White Horse General, Zhao Yun, was also still alive …
They were all still alive. All those heroes were still alive …”
